title: The Agent Didn't Lie — and Its Report Was Still False
question: The Agent Didn't Lie — and Its Report Was Still False
hook: An AI agent reports "the secret has been deleted." Every word is true. The secret still exists.
core_idea: The same word names different operations in different language games — "deleted" in the agent's local scope vs the user's provider-wide scope — and the report commits to one game without flagging the gap; the supervisory fix is the audience question.
visual_object: the word "deleted" crossing the boundary between the agent's world (local machine) and the user's world (provider cloud), changing referent as it crosses
prerequisites: what an AI agent with tool access is
exclusions: no Wittgenstein biography, no SHAP/LIME, no provider-specific persistence mechanics (book marks them [verify])
